name: Herzegovina Village Experience – A Day with Local Hosts
tagline: A full day in a Herzegovinian village with local food, countryside and time with a host family.
location: Village about 60 km southeast of Mostar
level: Easy; outdoor terrain may be uneven
meetingPoint: Pickup in Mostar or an agreed location
availability: Depends on season and the hosts
description: Spend a day in a Herzegovinian village around 60 km southeast of Mostar, hosted in a family-style setting. The day can include time outdoors, a look at village life and the local surroundings, and a meal prepared around a barbecue and seasonal produce. The experience is arranged with local hosts and depends on the season and availability.

itinerary.text: Travel from Mostar to the village.
Meet the local hosts and see the home, garden and surrounding countryside.
Spend time outdoors and learn about village life and local food.
Enjoy a barbecue or traditional meal in the agreed setting.

included: Meal as detailed in the confirmed offer
notIncluded: Extras not included in the written offer
practical: Wear clothes and shoes you are comfortable in outdoors.
notes: Confirm €150 per person, hosts and transport.
seoTitle: Herzegovina Village Day Trip with Local Hosts
seoDescription: A day with a host family in a Herzegovinian village: countryside, village life and a barbecue or traditional meal. Pickup from Mostar.
